feeds.what: all eight US House contests, statewide totals, one static HTML page
feeds.notes:
Each office has one page holding all of its districts: gen_results_2026_.html with n = 1 Governor / Lt. Governor, 2 Comptroller, 3 Attorney General, 4 Representative in Congress, 5 State Senator, 6 House of Delegates, 7 Judge of the Circuit Court, 8 Justice, Supreme Court of Maryland, 9 Judge, Appellate Court of Maryland At Large. Per-district pages are gen_results_2026__.html; note k is a running index, not the district (for the House of Delegates k=4 is district 2A). So the whole state count is nine office pages plus the questions page. Markup per contest:

office

District 1

Vote for 1

, a line '(309 of 309 election day precincts reported)', then with columns Name, Party, Early Voting, Election Day, Mail-In Ballot, Provisional, Total, Percentage and a Totals row. A count not yet in is the text 'NR'.
Statewide offices have <h2> only, no <h3> district heading.
Same markup. Multi-member districts say 'Vote for up to 2' or 'Vote for up to 3' in the <h4>.
Local questions are on gen_qresults_2026_1_ALL.html and per county on gen_qresults_2026_by_county_<1..24>.html (not fetched).

election_id: The year and 'general_results' in the path, and 'gen_…_2026_' in every file name: /elections/2026/general_results/gen_results_2026_<office>.html. The board's own short code for the election would be 'GG26' (the primary's data files are named GP26_…), but it does not appear in the live pages.
discovery: By pattern: https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/<year>/general_results/index.html (linked from /elections/<year>/index.html as 'Unofficial General Results'). The index lists every office page and district page. Machine-readable CSVs do exist, but only after the canvass: https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/election_data/index.html ('Data files') on 2026-11-10 lists only primary files (GP26_…Results.csv, GP26_AllPrecincts….csv) and still shows an unfilled template placeholder for the general ('{*GENERAL_ELECTION_CODE*}_Precincts_and_Polling_Places.xlsx').
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent: 200 on every page (Cloudflare in front, no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field:
Text in each page: '
Last refreshed: 11/10/2026 04:17:34 PM
', no zone; Maryland is on US Eastern time (I fetched it at about 6:30 PM Eastern, so this is the time the static page was last regenerated, not the request time). The responses carry no Last-Modified or Cache-Control header.
reporting_field: Text per contest: '(309 of 309 election day precincts reported)' next to the 'County Break Down' link. It counts election-day precincts only; early voting, mail-in and provisional are separate columns, each 'NR' until reported (Provisional was still NR for every contest on 2026-11-10). The index also links a 'Results Reporting Status by County' page (not fetched).

other_statewide: Judge, Appellate Court of Maryland At Large

choice_format:
Name and party are separate table cells: '
Andy Harris
Republican'. Party is spelled out ('Democratic', 'Republican', 'Green', 'Working Class Party', 'Unaffiliated'). Tickets are one name: 'Wes Moore and Aruna Miller'. Declared write-ins are 'Edward Shlikas (Write-In)'; the rest are a row 'Other Write-Ins' with an empty party. Votes have thousands separators and a leading space. Questions: rows 'For the Constitutional Amendment' and 'Against the Constitutional Amendment'; the heading is followed by the chapter and the short title ('(Ch. 155 of the 2026 Legislative Session) Arbitration Reform for State Employees Act of 2026').
district_field: The title is split across headings: the office is the <h2> ('Representative in Congress', 'State Senator', 'House of Delegates') and the district is the <h3> under it ('District 1', 'District 1A'). (The titles above join the two with a dash for readability; the dash is mine.) House of Delegates districts carry sub-district letters (1A, 1B, 1C, 2A … 47B).
terms: none found on the results pages (footer: 'Copyright ©2025 Maryland State Board of Elections'). https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/using_election_data_instructions.html (saved) explains that Election Law §11-402 requires the board to 'make available in an electronic format a report of election results', which is what the post-canvass CSVs are.
tried: GET https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/general_results/index.html (relay User-Agent): 200, 'Unofficial 2026 Gubernatorial General Election Results', 197 links to static gen_*.html pages.
